script.author: mc
script.description: Route, travel-time matrix and proxy settings for self-hosted OSRM routing

freeform.sql: UPDATE mapmanager SET spatialroute = 'http://esri-adapter.gis-routing.svc:8080/arcgis/rest/services/World/NAServer/Route' WHERE mapname = 'LBS_DEMO' AND (spatialroute IS NULL OR spatialroute LIKE '%arcgis.com%')

UPDATE mapmanager SET spatialdistancematrix = 'http://esri-adapter.gis-routing.svc:8080/arcgis/rest/services/World/NAServer/ODCostMatrix/solveODCostMatrix' WHERE mapname = 'LBS_DEMO' AND (spatialdistancematrix IS NULL OR spatialdistancematrix LIKE '%arcgis.com%')

freeform.description: Travel-time matrix (async job, more than 10 points) -> OSRM adapter
freeform.sql: UPDATE mapmanager SET spatialjobmatrix = 'http://esri-adapter.gis-routing.svc:8080/arcgis/rest/services/World/GPServer/GenerateOriginDestinationCostMatrix' WHERE mapname = 'LBS_DEMO' AND (spatialjobmatrix IS NULL OR spatialjobmatrix LIKE '%arcgis.com%')

freeform.description: Browser map calls go through Maximo's proxy
freeform.sql: UPDATE mapmanager SET useproxy = 1 WHERE mapname = 'LBS_DEMO' AND useproxy = 0
